a.lede: OpenAI is building out the pieces of an alternative to the traditional app store model, turning ChatGPT into a place where software can be discovered and used by people and AI agents alike.
a.title: OpenAI’s latest features take direct aim at the app store model

b.lede: OpenAI is expanding ChatGPT plugins with dedicated sidebar homes, interactive panels, file viewers, improved discovery, and support for automations.
b.title: OpenAI expands ChatGPT’s plugins with app-like interfaces and automations
